title: Attention at Absolute Zero
abstract: arXiv:2611.11937v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attention scores candidate supports of an answer, which we call witnesses, and reads the scores at a temperature. We build a higher-order attention layer whose state lives on pairs of items: for a pair (a, b), each third item k is a witness judged through its legs (a, k) and (k, b). It reads witnesses at zero temperature, keeping the best and the number tied with it, passes on only bits comparing such counts, rebuilds its pair state from the input and these bits at every loop, and is trained from answers alone. Each choice removes one way soft attention fails at size: dispersed weight, unresolved gaps between learned scores, and a drifting soft state. In maximum retrieval it is right on at least 99.95% of sets 1,000 times larger than in training, on all ten seeds; trained with a soft count, the same network falls to 42% at 4,096 items. translated_title: 绝对零度下的注意力机制
translated_abstract: 注意力机制对答案的候选支持（我们称之为“见证者”）进行评分，并在某个温度下读取这些分数。我们构建了一个高阶注意力层，其状态存在于物品对之上：对于一对，每个第三方物品 k 都是一个见证者，通过其两条边 和 进行评判。该层在零温度下读取见证者（保留最佳者及其对应的计数），只传递比较这些计数的比特，在每次循环中从输入和这些比特重建其配对状态，并且仅依靠答案进行训练。每一项设计选择都消除了软注意力在规模扩大时的一种失效模式：权重分散、学习到的分数之间无法区分的差距，以及漂移的软状态。在最大值检索任务中，该模型在比训练集大1,000倍的集合上，于全部十个随机种子下均达到至少99.95%的准确率；而使用软计数训练的同一网络在4,096个项目时性能降至42%。在无提示的CLRS-30基准上，该层的一般形式（其一半通道在零温度下读取……）
tldr: 该论文提出一种在零温度（硬最大值）下读取见证者的高阶配对注意力层，通过仅传递计数比较比特并在每轮循环重建状态，克服了软注意力在规模扩大时的权重分散、分数差距与状态漂移等失效模式，在比训练规模大1000倍的最大值检索任务上仍保持99.95%以上的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a higher-order pairwise attention layer that reads witnesses at zero temperature (hard max), passes only bits comparing counts, and rebuilds its state each loop, eliminating soft attention's failure modes at scale and achieving over 99.95% accuracy on maximum retrieval sets 1,000 times larger than training, where a soft-count-trained network drops to 42%.
